thesis: The speakers discuss the book 'The Almanack of Naval Ravikant,' which combines wealth and happiness based on wisdom from Naval Ravikant, a Silicon Valley icon who founded Angel List and invested in companies like Twitter and Uber. The host, Eric Jorgensen, describes his own investment approach as a mix of a value mindset for personal holdings and indexing, while also engaging in angel investing and starting a small venture fund to pursue high-multiple, power law returns within the tech ecosystem.
